name: Browser Workflow
description: Browser analysis, reporting, focus and public service launchers.

do-it-now.title: Do It Now
do-it-now.text: One change. The one I can make in the next 10 minutes on this screen that moves the most money. Just that one, with the clicks.

kill-rule.title: Kill Rule
kill-rule.text: Write kill criteria: exact metric, exact threshold, exact number of days. Something I can check in 30 seconds without thinking.

why.title: Why
why.text: Why that conclusion? Walk me through the numbers you used, in order. If any step is inference rather than data, label it.

risk.title: Risk
risk.text: What breaks if I do this? Worst case, how likely, and the cheapest way to test it first.

next-7.title: Next 7
next-7.text: Turn that into a 7-day plan. One action per day, each under 30 minutes. Day 1 starts today.

prove-it.title: Prove It
prove-it.text: Point to the exact rows, columns, and values on screen that support each claim. If you can't point to one, retract the claim.

argue-back.title: Argue Back
argue-back.text: Argue the opposite of what you just told me. Make the strongest case that I should do nothing. Then tell me which case is stronger and why.

client-words.title: Client Words
client-words.text: Rewrite that for the client. No jargon, no platform names they don't use, lead with the result. 6 lines max.

so-what.title: So What
so-what.text: Convert that into decisions. Each one: do X, by when, expected result, how I'll know it worked.

cheaper.title: Cheaper
cheaper.text: Same outcome, less spend. What's the low-budget version of that plan?

change-tone.title: Change Tone
change-tone.text: Rewrite the previous answer in [LANGUAGE / TONE], concise and clear. Keep every fact and number accurate.

top-3.title: Top 3
top-3.text: Out of everything you just said, what are the 3 highest-impact actions? Rank by impact-to-effort and drop the rest.

scale.title: Scale
scale.text: If this works, what's the scale-up sequence? Budget steps and the checkpoint at each.

save.title: Save
save.text: Output the whole thread as one clean markdown block: context, findings, decisions, next actions. Ready to paste into a doc.

waste.title: Waste
waste.text: Find the spend that isn't returning on this page. Give me a review list of proposed pauses with a threshold for each: kill if [metric] stays below [number] for [days]. Do not pause campaigns or change spend.

ga4.title: Ga4
ga4.text: Read this Analytics screen. What changed vs the previous period, which causes the evidence supports and which remain hypotheses, and what's noise? Ignore anything under [5]% movement.

audit.title: Audit
audit.text: Read the campaign data on this page. Give me: what's working, what's wasting money, and what's about to break. Use only numbers visible on screen - no assumptions. If a number I'd need is missing, say which one and where to find it.

creative.title: Creative
creative.text: Judge the ad creative and copy visible here as a [TARGET AUDIENCE] would see it. Hook, clarity, offer, CTA, language quality. Score each out of 10 and rewrite the weakest one.

search.title: Search
search.text: Read this Search Console screen. Which queries are one small fix away from page 1, and what's the fix?

insights.title: Insights
insights.text: From this page, give me the 5 non-obvious things a good media buyer would notice and a junior would miss. One line each, each tied to a specific number on screen.

audience.title: Audience
audience.text: Read the targeting setup on this screen. Where is it too broad, too narrow, or overlapping with another ad set?

store.title: Store
store.text: Read this store dashboard. Orders, AOV, top products, drop-offs. What's the one lever worth pulling this week?

tweaks.title: Tweaks
tweaks.text: List concrete changes I can make on this exact screen right now. For each: the change, where to click, expected effect, and risk. Rank by impact-to-effort. Max 7.

budget.title: Budget
budget.text: Check pacing on this page. Are we under- or over-spending vs the period? What should the budget be tomorrow, and why?

where-am-i.title: Where Am I
where-am-i.text: I just opened this page and lost the thread. In 4 lines: what am I looking at, what state is it in, what can be established about the next step, and what's the single next click.

winners.title: Winners
winners.text: Rank everything on this page by performance. Show the top 3 and tell me exactly why each is winning and whether it's scalable or a fluke.

funnel.title: Funnel
funnel.text: Open the destination URL from this page and audit the landing experience against the ad promise. Where does the message break?

page-summary.title: Page Summary
page-summary.text: Summarize this page in [LANGUAGE / TONE]: what works, what needs attention, and the next action. Use only visible evidence.

email.title: Email
email.text: Client email draft: subject line, 3 short paragraphs, one clear ask or next step. Warm, plain, no jargon.

next-month.title: Next Month
next-month.text: Write next month's plan: 3 initiatives, budget split, and the single metric that defines success.

weekly.title: Weekly
weekly.text: Build this week's report for [CLIENT] from the data on screen. Sections: headline result, spend vs return, what we changed, what we learned, next week. Numbers only from this page.

table.title: Table
table.text: Extract every metric on this page into a clean markdown table: metric, this period, last period, % change, verdict (good/watch/bad).

delivered.title: Delivered
delivered.text: List everything delivered this period, in client-facing language, suitable for attaching to an invoice.

monthly.title: Monthly
monthly.text: Build the monthly report for [CLIENT] from the data on screen: headline result, spend vs return, what we changed, what we learned, a vs-last-month table, and one strategic recommendation with a reason.

vs-last.title: Vs Last
vs-last.text: Compare this period to the previous one. Only surface changes over [10]%. For each, one sentence on the likely cause.

exec-5.title: Exec 5
exec-5.text: Five lines for someone who will not read more than five lines: result, spend, best channel, biggest problem, what we're doing about it.

wins.title: Wins
wins.text: Write the wins section. 3 wins, each with the number that proves it. No fluff wins.

client-update.title: Client Update
client-update.text: Draft a short client update in [LANGUAGE / TONE]: result first, what changed, and what happens next. Use only verified figures. Do not send.

issues.title: Issues
issues.text: Write the issues section. Each issue: what happened, impact in numbers, what we're doing, by when. Own it, don't hedge.

park-it.title: Park It
park-it.text: Capture [THOUGHT] as a short note in this chat, then return me to the current task. Do not persist it elsewhere without approval.

start-5.title: Start 5
start-5.text: I have 5 minutes and no motivation. Look at this page and give me one thing I can finish in 5 minutes. Not a plan. One thing.

brain-dump.title: Brain Dump
brain-dump.text: I'm going to dump everything in my head. Sort it into: do now, do this week, delegate, delete. Don't ask questions until I stop typing.

body-double.title: Body Double
body-double.text: Help me focus on [TASK] for 25 minutes. Define one finish line and a five-minute checkpoint. Check in when I return; do not promise timed background messages without a supported, authorized reminder tool.

one-thing.title: One Thing
one-thing.text: From everything on this screen, what is the single next action? Not a list. One action, one sentence, starting with a verb.

where-was-i.title: Where Was I
where-was-i.text: Recap this session: what I was doing, what I decided, what's unfinished, and the exact next click.

done.title: Done
done.text: Close out this session. Give me: what got done, what didn't, the one thing to start with tomorrow. Then stop - no encouragement, no summary of the summary.
